app.name: Bean English
app.tagline: Speak English with your little one every day

home.greeting: What shall we say to {{name}} today?

favorites.title: Favorite phrases
favorites.empty: No favorites yet — tap ⭐ on any phrase to save it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.offlineNotReady: Downloading offline data… keep the app open while online

install.title: Install Bean on iPhone
install.steps: Open in Safari → tap Share (□↑) → "Add to Home Screen". Then open the app from its icon to use it offline.

backup.title: Backup
backup.desc: Save child profiles, progress and favorites to a file. Back up regularly — iPhone may clear web data.
backup.importConfirm: Replace all current data with the backup from {{date}}?

offline.pageDesc: Choose topics to listen to without internet. Other topics still show text but need internet for audio.
offline.removeAllConfirm: Delete all offline audio? You can download it again later.

age.label: Age
age.showAllHint: By default only phrases for the selected child's age are shown.
age.empty: No phrases for {{band}} in this topic yet.

streak.doneToday: Done for today 🎉 See you tomorrow!
streak.notYet: Not yet today — play one phrase to keep the streak!

diary.title: Child's diary
diary.empty: When your child says a phrase, tap "Child said it" on it — the moment will be saved here.
diary.notePlaceholder: Note (e.g. said it at the park)

cards.title: Word cards
cards.noneDue: All reviewed for today! Pick a deck to learn new words.
cards.startHint: Pick a deck below to start learning new words.
cards.frontHint: Listen and guess what it is!
cards.loadError: Couldn't load the deck. Check your connection and try again.
cards.swipeHint: Tip: swipe right = Got it · swipe left = Not yet

reminder.title: Daily reminder
reminder.onHint: Every day at {{time}} with an English phrase
reminder.offHint: Get one notification a day at a time you choose
reminder.testSent: Test sent — it should arrive in a moment.
reminder.denied: Notifications are blocked. Go to iPhone Settings → Notifications → Bean to allow them.
reminder.tooSoon: Wait a minute before sending another test.
reminder.error: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
reminder.installFirst: To get notifications on iPhone: tap Share → Add to Home Screen, then open Bean from the home-screen icon.

tour.replayDone: Done! Tips will show again as you open each page.

home-today.title: Today
home-today.body: Start each day here: review the word cards due, continue the topic you were on, and see your child's streak.

home-search.title: Quick search
home-search.body: Type Vietnamese or English (e.g. đói, bath, sleep) to find the phrase you need right now.

home-suggested.title: Ideas for right now
home-suggested.body: Topics and 3 phrases picked for this time of day: waking up, meals, bath, bedtime…

home-topic.title: Topics
home-topic.body: Each topic has phrases and short dialogues. The green bar shows how many you've learned.

home-avatar.title: Your child's corner
home-avatar.body: Tap the avatar to see the streak, stickers, word cards and to change the avatar.

topic-tabs.title: Phrases & dialogues
topic-tabs.body: Switch between single phrases and short parent–child dialogues.

phrase-play.title: Tap to listen
phrase-play.body: Tap a phrase to hear it, then say it to your child. Orange phrases are for your child to say.

phrase-actions.title: Track progress
phrase-actions.body: ✓ I know it · 💬 my child said it · ☆ save to favorites. Progress is kept per child.

phrase-slots.title: Swap a word
phrase-slots.body: Tap another word to make a new sentence — a different food, toy and so on.

topic-play-all.title: Play the whole topic
topic-play-all.body: Plays every phrase in a row — handy when your hands are busy.

topic-offline.title: Use offline
topic-offline.body: Download this topic's audio to listen without a connection.

dialogue-line.title: Each line
dialogue-line.body: Tap a line to hear it. Each colour is a speaker: mom, dad or child.

dialogue-play.title: Play it all
dialogue-play.body: Hear the whole dialogue, then act it out together with your child.

cards-review.title: Today's review
cards-review.body: Words your child knows come back less often (1, 3, 7, 14… days); missed ones come back soon. The badge on the Cards tab counts cards due.

cards-deck.title: Decks by topic
cards-deck.body: Open a deck to see its words and learn new ones — up to 10 new words per session.

deck-study.title: Study
deck-study.body: Starts a session: cards due first, then new words.

deck-word.title: Word details
deck-word.body: Tap a word to hear it and see 5 example sentences to use with your child.

deck-offline.title: Use offline
deck-offline.body: Download this deck's audio to study without a connection.

study-card.title: Listen and guess
study-card.body: Show the picture, tap the speaker and let your child guess. Tap the card to flip it for the answer and examples.

study-flip.title: Did they know it?
study-flip.body: After flipping: swipe right (Know it) if they did, swipe left (Again) to see the word again sooner.

study-shuffle.title: Shuffle
study-shuffle.body: On: cards come in random order. Off: in order.

progress-child.title: Each child
progress-child.body: More than one child? Tap to switch — each has their own progress. The gear adds or edits profiles.

progress-stats.title: Totals
progress-stats.body: Phrases you know, phrases your child said, words learned and the current streak.

progress-week.title: Last 7 days
progress-week.body: Each bar is a day's activity: phrases played, marks and card reviews.

avatar-streak.title: Streak
avatar-streak.body: Any day with a phrase played or a card reviewed counts. Longer streaks unlock avatar accessories.

avatar-stickers.title: Stickers
avatar-stickers.body: Earned at milestones: sessions, words learned, streak days, phrases your child said.

avatar-look.title: Change the avatar
avatar-look.body: Pick an animal, colour and unlocked accessories — kids love choosing!

settings-profiles.title: Child profiles
settings-profiles.body: Add a child with name and age — content is filtered to their age.

settings-reminder.title: Daily reminder
settings-reminder.body: Get a notification at the time you choose. On iPhone, open the app from its home-screen icon.

settings-offline.title: Use offline
settings-offline.body: See storage used and download audio for use without a connection.

settings-backup.title: Backup
settings-backup.body: Export a file to keep progress safe or move it to another device.

settings-tour.title: Show tips again
settings-tour.body: Want to see these tips again? Tap here any time.
